title: Arcanar
tagline: Monetize your project faster than ever by turning it into an NFT.
description:
Arcanar is a DApp built on Polygon that helps project owners to monetize their project faster than ever.
You simple turn your project info into an NFT and people can buy, sell it or invest in it for the long run.
Arcanar aims to make it easy for founders to monetize or raise investments for their projects. And it also removes the friction & bureaucracy needed to fund or trade an early stage project in the current world.
how_its_made:
Arcanar is built with ReactJS, Web3JS, Solidity (ERC1155 standard) and it is deployed on Polygon.

The functionality of meta transactions is implemented so users can easily mint NFTs for free, something which is super hard if users need to fund their wallets with Matic. Used IPFS/Filecoin to store nft metadata via web3storage nft.storage. Used Biconomy and EIP2771 standard for meta transactions for gasless minting.
